leadText:
(Japanese: ギバン島 Giban Island) is an -exclusive island in Hoenn that appeared in Showdown At Linoone. It is located somewhere between Sootopolis City and . Kimmy Shoney lives there with his parents Korban and Harmony.

The island features a large square mountain and is covered in dense forest. It also has a Pokémon Center.

 and boarded a ship to Giban Island, hoping the stop would be a good location for Ash to train for the upcoming Ever Grande Conference, and for to train for her next . The group ultimately got little in, however, after a , nicknamed Tokin, stole two of May's s due to its habit of random items.
